[center][color=#d4d4d8]
I always imagined Camilla to be a bit wilder, with her constant teasing and slightly sassy comments - so i decided to give her a more untamed, curly hairstyle and thus I present to you this art replacer.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]For the spirtes I mainly tweaked this mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30752]Camila Sprite Retexture[/url][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]I asked the author for their permission, but unfortunatly their account has been deleted and therefor I didn't recive a reply.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]However, should the author return and ask me to remove this mod, I’ll be happy to do so.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]First of all you'll need these two mods: [/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753][/url][/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969][/url][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Second: This replacer consists of two parts.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8] [/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]The main part replaces the art inside of this folder. [CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE.[/color][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]As for those of you striving for perfection, I've also added a replacer for the "flying carpet" sprite in the Stardew Valley Expanded folder. [/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#D4D4D8]Of course,you can decide for yourselves whether you want to replace everything or only the the sprites and portraits from the "seasonal cute" mod.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54496/54496-1792929210-2032766703.png[/img][/center]
[center]Since this is just an art replacer: [/center]
[center] [/center]
[center]Just unzip the file and drop the artwork into the original mod folders.[/center]
[center]Because I kept the original folder structure, you should be able to copy & paste everything and then simply click "yes" to replace. [/center]
[center][/center]
[center]As mentioned before: consider whether you want to replace everything or only the portraits and sprites. [/center]
